question: Who among the following is the first ever recipient of Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishwanathan Anand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **Vishwanathan Anand** is an Indian chess grandmaster and a former world chess champion.

• He was the first recipient of the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award** in 1991-92, India's highest sporting honor.

• Anand has won the World Chess Championship five times and has been one of the world's top players for over two decades.

• He has received numerous accolades, including the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**

• It is the highest sporting honor of the Republic of India.

• The award is named after Rajiv Gandhi, former Prime Minister of India, and was instituted in the year 1991-92.

• It is awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

• The award carries a medallion, a certificate, and a cash prize.

• **Dhyan Chand**

• He was a legendary Indian field hockey player, often referred to as "The Wizard" for his incredible ball control and goal-scoring abilities.

• Dhyan Chand won three Olympic gold medals in field hockey for India, in 1928, 1932, and 1936.

• Though a remarkable athlete, he was not a recipient of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.

• **Virat Kohli**

• He is an Indian cricketer and former captain of the Indian national team.

• Virat Kohli has received numerous awards, including the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in 2018.

• He is one of the leading batsmen in the world and has set numerous records in international cricket.

• **Sunil Chhetri**

• He is an Indian professional footballer and the captain of the Indian national football team.

• Sunil Chhetri is one of the highest goal scorers in international football among active players, alongside Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi.

• He was awarded the Khel Ratna Award in 2021.
